offset_rule: Blob offset equals decoded address minus load address.

observations.setup_effect: Clear gate bit 31 and divider bits 4:0, then set update bit 27 and poll its completion.
observations.selection_effect: Clear selector bits 26:24 and set 0x8b000000, selecting PERI0_600M with gate and update set. Divider remains zero.
Clear selector bits 26:24 and set 0xcb000000, selecting PERI0_600M with reset deasserted, gate and update set. Other divider fields are retained.
observations.branch_effect: The branch at 0x57af0 through 0x57b56 changes the MBUS divider and rejoins before this NSI selection.

conclusion: Both decoded board-setup and DRAM-clock sequences select NSI mux 3, PERI0_600M. The current read-only decoder supports that parent.
limitation: Static binary behavior does not establish a fresh board register value or exclude a later writer. Diagnostic clock readback remains authoritative.
